scope: Independent bounded static review of four B5 production files, three test files and B3/B4 ownership/shutdown contracts. No original targets opened, executed or modified; no actual user CFG/token/achievement contents read. Full common build not run by reviewer.
prior_source_preservation_evidence: Independently compared every B4 source-snapshot entry from the prior delivery ZIP against current file SHA-256; all 710 entries identical.

findings.conclusion: Seven selected Dependencies methods bind recovered parent/join/filename/filesystem encoding and explicit compiler-CRT predicates/Win32 environment call. Fourteen application/OS policies remain owned and delegated; no full default configuration provider is claimed.
filesystem_widen_010540 uses the existing filesystem code-page algorithm. Unestablished UTF-8 widen, narrow-path and relative-resolution policies stay delegated rather than being guessed.

isspace receives an unsigned byte; tolower admits only unsigned-char values or EOF. Negative non-EOF signed-byte inputs fail before invoking C-library undefined behavior. This is an explicit reconstruction domain bound, not original multibyte/locale equivalence.
CompilerConsole is immovable, so opaque tokens into its three FILE* slots remain stable. Reopen validates equal observed source/output identities and never treats a foreign token as a FILE record.

freopen_s receives a separate valid FILE* output cell and the existing FILE* value. No original 0x58-byte MSVC FILE layout is aliased, copied or dereferenced. Closed/null slots after a failed compiler reopen are rejected on reuse; source API failure codes remain visible.

bind_configuration_and_console constructs source providers before publication and retains an explicitly selected console. Construction does not invoke application entry, open a console, load target DLLs or change environment state.

Each create operation allocates its envelope before the SDK CreateThread call. The native callback copies provider/context identities and deletes the envelope before entering recovered thread_entry_05e7a8, avoiding reliance on C++ destructors after ExitThread.
After successful CreateThread, the creator uses only returned handle/ID and never rereads the envelope or Context, which a fast worker may already have released.
Normal SDK failure deletes the unconsumed envelope, preserves the failure LastError and leaves caller ID untouched. The recovered begin-thread body remains responsible for Context failure cleanup.

An injected CreateThread exception with unknown worker outcome intentionally does not free the envelope. B3 TrackingThreads marks the attempt poisoned and cannot establish successful shutdown; no fabricated rollback or worker quiescence is inferred.

The SDK callback has DWORD WINAPI(void*) and exact CreateThread function-pointer type. Application invocation remains the existing unsigned __stdcall(void*) route; stack size and source operands retain the Windows x64 widths.

make_recovered_threads constructs the existing concrete crt_glue::ThreadEffects and the outer launch wrapper, with explicit referenced runtime/PTD/heap/error/invalid state and a mandatory shared lifetime owner. The private lower create method is replaced by the outer method that builds Launch envelopes; no per-image provider router is introduced.

NativeThreads keeps its shared domain owner alive through lower-provider destruction. Joined-worker/FLS completion remains mandatory before destroying the outer provider. B3/B4 controlled close supplies this ordering for correctly admitted/tracked workers.

Core source tests cover explicit path/encoding/ctype failures, observed console branches, stream identity rejection and native worker callback entry/exit. Integration uses three own Win32 workers started serially during synthetic join, memory-only config inputs and injected console/encoding/provider effects. Counter checks occur before ResumeThread or after WaitForSingleObject, excluding concurrent mutation of the shared non-atomic test counter.

This package assembles existing source algorithms with new ownership/adapter code. It adds no recovered native body, native provider closure or PE entry. Nine remaining Bootstrap Services policies are unchanged; compiler-console completion does not close foreign CRT/FILE ABI equivalence.

limits: No independently executed test run or full common build is claimed by this static reviewer; parent reported 53 core and 110 integration quick checks. Authoritative common validation must capture actual final counts and frozen source hashes.

The complete actual CRT ThreadDomain graph and its FLS teardown are supplied by the caller. make_recovered_threads construction/type selection is statically reviewed; the new integration test executes NativeThreads with a controlled lower provider rather than a complete original-native CRT domain.

The raw NativeThreads provider has no implicit join or safe active-worker destructor. B3 TrackingThreads or its caller must exclude future entries and join all pending/suspended workers plus FLS teardown before provider destruction.

Launch bookkeeping uses the real current-thread Win32 GetLastError/SetLastError domain. Injected create functions and the lower provider's last_error must use that same domain for equivalent error propagation.
An unknown throwing CreateThread provider may leave an envelope retained permanently; that failure is fail-closed via B3 poison, not a recoverable successful teardown.

CompilerConsole is an explicitly selected rebuilt compiler-CRT policy. Original MSVC FILE memory layout, aliasing side effects, invalid-parameter behavior and failure cleanup ABI are not proved equivalent. Stream use and external CRT stream mutations must be serialized by the caller.
Compiler C locale and original static CRT locale/multibyte behavior may differ. Negative non-EOF signed-char tolower input is deliberately outside this adapter's supported domain.

The configuration bridge still requires fourteen lower configuration policies, including licensing, persistence and actual filesystem effects. Source providers must obey their own lifetime and synchronization contracts.
General concurrent native Execution behavior, foreign STL/EH/SEH/object ABI, actual provider completeness, loader-lock-safe shutdown, image unload and PE-entry wiring remain open B3/B4 gates.
No original binary execution, original file modification, real user configuration content read or complete DLL runtime equivalence is established.
